title: Aman
hint: the Blessed Realm, the Undying Lands in the West

title: Valinor
hint: land of the Valar west of the Pelóri, from the mountains to the Outer Sea

title: Eldamar
hint: Elvenhome: the coast and bay east of the Calacirya, with Tirion and Alqualondë

title: Araman
hint: cold waste between the Pelóri and the sea in the north; the Doom of Mandos was spoken here

title: Avathar
hint: narrow dark land between the Pelóri and the sea in the south; Ungoliant dwelt in a ravine here

title: Oiomúrë
hint: region of mists on the coast of Araman near the Helcaraxë

title: Helcaraxë
hint: the Grinding Ice between Araman and Middle-earth; Fingolfin crossed it

title: Shadowy Seas
hint: dark seas east of Tol Eressëa, shadowed after the Hiding of Valinor (after the Flight of the Noldor)

title: Pastures of Yavanna
hint: the fields of Yavanna in the south of Valinor, west of the woods of Oromë
